blocks.arabic_text: الْقِسْطَ وَيَرْفَعُهُ، يُرْفَعُ إِلَيْهِ عَمَلُ اللَّيْلِ قَبْلَ عَمَلِ النَّهَارِ، وَعَمَلُ النَّهَارِ قَبْلَ عَمَلِ اللَّيْلِ، حِجَابُهُ النُّورُ لَوْكَشَفَهُ لَاحْرَقَتْ سُبُحَاتُ وَجْهِهِ مَاانْتَهَي إِلَيْهِ بَصَرُهُ مِنْ خَلْقِهِ.
blocks.source_reference_arabic: رواه مسلم باب في قوله ﷻ ان الله لاينام......، رقم:٤٤٥
blocks.tamil_translation: Hazrat Abu Musa Ash'ari (RA) narrates that once the Prophet ﷺ told us five sentences: “1. Allah does not sleep, and sleep is not befitting for Him. 2. He lowers and raises the scale. 3. The deeds done at night (are all) raised up to Him before the deeds of the day (that follows), 4. and the deeds done in the day (are all raised up to Him) before the deeds of the night (that follows). 5. His veil (between Him and the creation) is made of light. If He were to remove that veil, the splendour of His Noble Face would burn up all of His creation that His gaze reaches.”

blocks.arabic_text: عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ ﵂ قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللهِ ﷺ: إِنَّ اللهَ خَلَقَ إِسْرَافِيلَ مُنْذُ يَوْمِ خَلَقَهُ صَآفاًّ قَدَمَيْهِ لَا يَرْفَعُ بَصَرَهُ، بَيْنَهُ وَبَيْنَ الرَّبِّ تَبَارَكَ وَتَعَالَي سَبْعُونَ نُورًا مَا مِنْهَا مِنْ نُورٍ يَدْنُو مِنْهُ إِلَّا احْتَرَقَ.
blocks.tamil_translation: “From the day Allah created Hazrat Israfil (AS), he has been standing with both his feet set evenly, without raising his gaze upward. Between him and Allah there are seventy lights as a veil. (Those veils of light are such that) if Hazrat Israfil (AS) were to go near them, each one of them would burn him up!” Hazrat Ibn Abbas (RA) narrates that the Prophet ﷺ said.
